feed.title: Qatar eVTOL Reference Dataset — recently verified
feed.subtitle: Entities whose claims were most recently re-checked against their primary sources.

entry.title: Did Not Make The Cut: 13 Entities We Cut
entry.summary: We cut 13 candidate eVTOL entities from the Arab-world database because they failed our contracted/built/flight-tested/regulated bar. Honest disclosure of what was considered and rejected, with primary sources.

entry.title: Port of Doha ↔ Katara Cultural Village
entry.summary: The EHang EH216-S completed first urban human-carrying pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East between Port of Doha and Katara Cultural Village on 17 November 2025. 8-minute flight vs ~30 minutes by car.

entry.title: Qatar Ministry of Transport (MoT)
entry.summary: Qatar Ministry of Transport (MoT) provided strategic support for EHang EH216-S first urban pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East (17 Nov 2025). Minister HE Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulla bin Mohammed Al Thani.

entry.title: Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA)
entry.summary: The Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA) issued operational authorization for EHang EH216-S first urban pilotless eVTOL flights in the Middle East on 17 November 2025. Distinct from MoT.

entry.title: Doha Airport → Urban Centers (future)
entry.summary: EHang named airport-to-urban shuttle as a Qatar eVTOL focus area in Nov 2025. No specific HIA → Doha route announced. Status and sources verified.

entry.title: Doha Airport Vertiport (planned)
entry.summary: Conceptual eVTOL vertiport at Hamad International Airport (HIA), Doha. No formal announcement by HIA, Qatar Airways, MoT or QCAA. Status and sources verified.

entry.title: Doha eVTOL vs taxi vs metro — comparison
entry.summary: Compares Doha eVTOL (EHang EH216-S, 8 min trial), Karwa taxi (~30 min, ~QAR 25-35) and Doha Metro (~30 min, QAR 2) on the Port–Katara corridor.

entry.title: EHang EH216-S (Qatar trials)
entry.summary: EHang EH216-S autonomous eVTOL flew the Middle East's first urban pilotless passenger flights in Doha on 15 November 2025. Specs, regulator, sources verified.

entry.title: Gulf eVTOL — UAE vs Qatar compared
entry.summary: Compares the UAE eVTOL programme (Joby S4 piloted, Dubai 2026 launch) and the Qatar eVTOL programme (EHang EH216-S pilotless, Doha trial Nov 2025).

entry.title: Qatar autonomous (pilotless) eVTOL — explained
entry.summary: Explains how Qatar's first urban pilotless eVTOL — EHang EH216-S, flown Doha 17 Nov 2025 — operates without a pilot, under QCAA authorisation.

entry.title: Qatar eVTOL & National Vision 2030
entry.summary: How Qatar's first urban pilotless eVTOL trial (Doha, 17 Nov 2025) maps to Qatar National Vision 2030, the MoT 2025-2030 strategy and NDS3.

entry.title: Qatar — Future Certified Aircraft (placeholder)
entry.summary: No specific certified eVTOL aircraft has been named for Qatar commercial operations beyond the EH216-S trials. Status, MoT framework and sources verified.
